verdict.rationale: Checkout.com is an API-first payments platform. It documents server-side machine authentication via OAuth 2.0 client credentials, a dedicated test/sandbox environment, idempotent retries for automated calls, and an official Node.js SDK, so it can be driven headlessly by scripts and pipelines. Nothing documents CI-specific usage. missing for 10: an official CLI, CI/CD pipeline guidance or examples, a documented non-interactive sandbox workflow for automated tests, and independent hands-on corroboration.
